metadata.title: Tom Gayner's Top Q2 2026 Move: MercadoLibre Inc at a 0.24% Portfolio Impact

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Markel's Co-CEO doubles down on Latin American e-commerce giant while trimming tech exposure
Tom Gayner (Trades, Portfolio), Co-Chief Executive Officer of Markel Corporation, recently submitted the 13F filing for the second quarter of 2026, revealing a significant strategic shift in his portfolio. Gayner, who joined Markel in 1990 to form Markel Gayner Asset Management, oversees the company's investing activities alongside its diverse industrial and service businesses. His investment philosophy, outlined in Markel's 2019 Letter to Shareholders, emphasizes four key disciplines: seeking businesses earning good returns with modest leverage, backing management teams with talent and integrity, identifying opportunities for capital reinvestment or shareholder returns, and acquiring holdings at fair prices where long-term returns align with intrinsic value growth.
Summary of New Buy
Tom Gayner (Trades, Portfolio) added a total of 3 stocks to his portfolio during the quarter, with the most significant addition being Zoetis Inc (NYSE:ZTS), acquiring 66,195 shares valued at $4.76 million, representing 0.04% of the portfolio. The second largest new position was Netflix Inc (NASDAQ:NFLX), with 40,000 shares totaling $2.86 million, accounting for approximately 0.02% of the portfolio. The third addition was UFP Industries Inc (NASDAQ:UFPI), with 4,000 shares valued at $362,960.
Key Position Increases
Gayner increased stakes in 24 stocks during the quarter, with MercadoLibre Inc (NASDAQ:MELI) standing out as the most notable adjustment. The additional 18,550 shares brought the total to 24,000 shares, representing a substantial 340.37% increase in share count. This move had a 0.24% impact on the current portfolio, with a total value of $40.74 million. The second largest increase was in Enterprise Products Partners LP (NYSE:EPD), with an additional 367,000 shares bringing the total to 569,000 sharesa 181.68% increase valued at $20.92 million.
Summary of Sold Out
Tom Gayner (Trades, Portfolio) completely exited 2 holdings in the second quarter of 2026. The Scotts Miracle Gro Co (NYSE:SMG) saw all 168,000 shares sold, resulting in a -0.09% impact on the portfolio. Additionally, UnitedHealth Group Inc (NYSE:UNH) was fully liquidated, with all 18,700 shares sold, causing a -0.04% impact on the portfolio.
Key Position Reduces
Gayner also reduced positions in 3 stocks, with the most significant changes including Meta Platforms Inc (NASDAQ:META), reduced by 14,140 sharesa -5.69% decrease in shares and a -0.07% portfolio impact. The stock traded at an average price of $610.86 during the quarter and has returned -8.94% over the past 3 months and -15.51% year-to-date. Analog Devices Inc (NASDAQ:ADI) was also reduced by 23,574 shares, representing a -2.3% reduction and a -0.06% portfolio impact. ADI traded at an average price of $394.57 during the quarter, returning -8.41% over the past 3 months but showing a 36.27% gain year-to-date.
